name: Weight on the Bell
summary: The clocktower's new bell must be carried from the south footbridge to the Round by dusk.

stages.journal: Solomon Roderick needs the new clocktower bell carried by cart from the footbridge to the Round by dusk.
objectives: Carry the bell to the Round
stages.hint: Go to the cart at the south footbridge.

stages.journal: The bell hangs in the clocktower.
We left the bell on its cart, and Solomon sent a labourer to fetch it.
